title: chat-server: Space/set create silently drops unknown properties
description: handle_space_set create copies only registered space_extension_properties into Space::extra and ignores every other unknown key (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs ~L1052), while the update path rejects an unknown key as invalidProperties naming it (tests/space_extension_properties.rs unregistered_property_is_invalid_properties). RFC 8620 §5.3 invalidProperties: 'The record given is invalid in some way'. Observed while testing jmap-chat-calendars-server with mayBindCalendar:false: a create carrying calendarId succeeds with calendarId dropped instead of being refused. Decide whether create should reject unknown keys like update.
